# ContractorFX

> Browser-local international contractor payout fee and FX spread comparator across Wise, Payoneer, Deel, Remote, and SWIFT bank wires.

ContractorFX models monthly SaaS seat fees, funding rail costs (ACH, wire, corporate card), fixed local withdrawal fees, and retail exchange rate spreads against reference mid-market interbank rates. Every calculation, CSV team roster audit, and Markdown or CSV routing memo export executes locally in the browser with zero server uploads.

Rate methodology and independence disclaimer: Independent fee modeling tool; not financial or tax advice; not affiliated with Wise, Payoneer, Deel, or Remote. Reference mid-market rates and published schedule estimates as of Nov 2026; verify live checkout quotes before transfer.

## Core Calculators and Audit Tools

- [Wise vs Payoneer Calculator](https://contractorfx.com/): Default $3,500 USD to INR contractor payout benchmark across all five payout providers.
- [Wise vs Payoneer Fee Calculator](https://contractorfx.com/wise-vs-payoneer-fee-calculator/): Detailed conversion spread and local bank withdrawal comparison defaulted to $2,000 USD to PHP.
- [Deel vs Remote Contractor Calculator](https://contractorfx.com/deel-vs-remote-contractor-calculator/): Multi-contractor SaaS seat cost ($49 vs $29/mo) and BRL FX spread comparison for 5-contractor teams.
- [Deel vs Wise Contractor Payouts](https://contractorfx.com/deel-vs-wise-contractor-payouts/): 8-contractor USD to EUR team payout benchmark with downloadable CFO routing memos.
- [Deel Withdrawal Fee Calculator](https://contractorfx.com/deel-withdrawal-fee-calculator/): Contractor cash-out deduction model for $3,000 USD to MXN across wire and local rails.
- [Batch Contractor Payout CSV Audit](https://contractorfx.com/batch-contractor-payout-csv-audit/): Client-side multi-corridor CSV roster fee auditor computing monthly and 12-month team FX savings.

## Methodology, Privacy, and Governance

- [About and Fee Methodology](https://contractorfx.com/about/): How ContractorFX models mid-market interbank rates, SaaS seat fees, funding rails, and local bank withdrawal spreads.
- [Privacy Policy](https://contractorfx.com/privacy/): 100% browser-local payroll computation architecture, zero CSV upload guarantee, and sanitized attribution analytics.
- [Terms of Use and Disclaimers](https://contractorfx.com/terms/): Non-affiliation notice, financial modeling scope, and live quote verification requirements.

## Supported Currencies and Providers

- Billing currencies: USD, EUR, GBP
- Payout currencies: EUR, GBP, INR, PHP, BRL, MXN, CNY, CAD
- Benchmarked providers: Wise, Payoneer, Deel, Remote, SWIFT Wire
- Discovery index: https://contractorfx.com/sitemap-index.xml
